communityAid.title: Humanitarian Aid and Family Support
communityAid.intro: Supporting our community means responding to practical needs. Alianza Ecuatoriana Internacional brings people together to provide food support for families through Centro Comunitario Andino.
communityAid.initiativesIntro: A look at past initiatives and the people who make this community support possible.
communityAid.archiveNote: This initiative has already taken place. Contact Centro Comunitario Andino to ask about future distributions, dates and availability.

turkeys2025.title: Turkey distribution for families in Queens
turkeys2025.copy: On November 18, 2025, Alianza Ecuatoriana Internacional announced a turkey distribution for local families, made possible through the efforts of Queens Assemblymember Catalina Cruz.
turkeys2025.details: The initiative was coordinated through Centro Comunitario Andino, on the second floor of 104-08 Roosevelt Avenue, Corona. The announcement offered one turkey per family and directed people to contact the center to arrange collection.
